svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 100 mm of 40 x 3 strip. Bend 25 mm at each end to 90 degrees,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: same way, to make a U: base 50 mm, two lugs 25 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Base: two 6.5 mm holes, 10 and 38 mm from the rear end, centred.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lugs: one 8 mm hole each, 15 mm from the base face, centred.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: base flat on the outside of the chain-side rail at its front end,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: lugs pointing outward; two M6 bolts through the rail.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The arm pivots on an M8 pin through both lugs with a 12 mm spacer

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each side of the arm; it folds up and is held by a spring clip.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the arm swings up and down freely and stops level.
